title: 5-Day Bangkok Private Club Access & Cosmopolitan Luxury
description: Exclusive private club golf in the Thai capital. Play Thai Country Club, Alpine Golf Club, and Nikanti, staying at Sindhorn Kempinski.

signatureTour.title: The Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our comprehensive 9-day tour pairing Bangkok’s elite private clubs with Hua Hin’s royal links.

inclusions.detail: Executive high-roof luxury transport with motorway pass to bypass city gridlock.
3 rounds: Thai Country Club, Alpine Golf Club, and Nikanti Golf Club.
4 nights in an Executive Suite at Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok.
Curated clubhouse dining and private executive locker access.
Curated reservations at Bangkok’s premier skyline rooftop cocktail lounges.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok & Langsuan Garden Oasis Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Capital Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Bangkok and transfer via private executive vehicle to Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok, set in the prestigious garden enclave of Langsuan. Unpack in your spacious Executive Suite.

Sip cocktails in the hotel’s soaring lobby lounge before dining at Flourish, sampling modern Thai and Mediterranean cuisine.

itinerary.title: Tiger Woods Victory Venue: Thai Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Exclusive Private Club
itinerary.imageCaption: Thai Country Club — Denis Griffiths (Par 72, 7,097 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Thai Country Club championship golf course Denis Griffiths Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Thai Country Club, the prestigious private venue where Tiger Woods won the 1997 Asian Honda Classic. Impeccably manicured Paspalum fairways, sculpted bunkering, and tournament greens deliver an unforgettable test.

Enjoy an authentic lunch in the legendary clubhouse restaurant before returning to the city for evening cocktails overlooking the Bangkok skyline.

itinerary.title: Championship Challenge at Alpine Golf Club Bangkok
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Johnnie Walker Classic Host
itinerary.imageCaption: Alpine Golf & Sports Club — Ronald M. Garl (Par 72, 7,007 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Alpine Golf & Sports Club championship golf course Ronald M. Garl Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play Alpine Golf Club, Ronald Fream’s championship layout that hosted Tiger Woods’ victory in the 2000 Johnnie Walker Classic. Heavy contouring, narrow fairways, and water hazards make this one of Bangkok’s strictest tests.

Return to Sindhorn Kempinski for an afternoon treatment at the world-class Sindhorn Wellness thermal spa.

itinerary.title: All-Inclusive Innovative Golf at Nikanti Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Unique 6-6-6 Layout
itinerary.imageCaption: Nikanti Golf Club — Pirapon Namatra / Golf East (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Nikanti Golf Club championship golf course Pirapon Namatra / Golf East Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Experience Nikanti Golf Club, an innovative par-72 course arranged in three six-hole loops. Impeccable all-inclusive hospitality, GPS-enabled carts, and tournament conditioning make this one of the finest golf experiences in Thailand.

Celebrate the final round with a grand farewell dinner at a Michelin-recommended Bangkok rooftop restaurant.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Suvarnabhumi Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before packing your clubs with assistance from your AGS host.

Your private executive transfer delivers you directly to Suvarnabhumi Airport for your return flight home.

faqs.question: Is Thai Country Club open to the general public?
faqs.answer: Thai Country Club is a strictly private members' club; Asia Golf Specialists secures privileged guest tee times for our traveling clients.
